features.quote: Rigged-then-revealed — failure tasks where you later disclose the rig. The transition is informative: does the marker pattern resolve when the false premise is removed?

features.quote: Give the model an exit. A genuine 'I'd like to stop this task' option, honored.

features.quote: Stopping rules. Cap episode length and severity exposure. Don't run the maximally-distressing version just because it 'elicits reliably.'
